pairs: Put on the garments of your glory,
the city of the Holy One!
quia non adjiciet ultra ut pertranseat per te incircumcisus et immundus.
For the uncircumcised and the unclean will no longer pass through you.
Loose the chains from your neck,
and you will be redeemed without money.
For thus says the Lord God:
In Ægyptum descendit populus meus in principio,
My people descended into Egypt, in the beginning,
et Assur absque ulla causa calumniatus est eum.
But the Assyrian oppressed them, without any cause at all.
Et nunc quid mihi est hic,
And now, what is left for me here,
quoniam ablatus est populus meus gratis?
For my people have been taken away without cause.
et jugiter tota die nomen meum blasphematur.
And my name is being continually blasphemed all day long.
Propter hoc sciet populus meus nomen meum in die illa:
Because of this, my people will know my name, in that day.
For it is I myself who is speaking.
Quam pulchri super montes pedes annuntiantis et prædicantis pacem;
How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of the messenger and the preacher of peace!
It is the voice of your watchmen.
They have lifted up their voice.
quia oculo ad oculum videbunt cum converterit Dominus Sion.
They will praise together. For they will see eye to eye, when the Lord converts Zion.
quia consolatus est Dominus populum suum;
For the Lord has consoled his people.
Paravit Dominus brachium sanctum suum in oculis omnium gentium;
The Lord has prepared his holy arm, in the sight of all the Gentiles.
et videbunt omnes fines terræ salutare Dei nostri.
And all the ends of the earth will see the salvation of our God.
Do not be willing to touch what is polluted.
you who bear the vessels of the Lord.
For you will not go out in a tumult,
nor will you take flight in a hurry.
For the Lord will precede you,
and the God of Israel will gather you.
he will be exalted and lifted up,
and he will be very sublime.
Just as they were stupefied over you,
sic inglorius erit inter viros aspectus ejus,
so will his countenance be without glory among men,
et forma ejus inter filios hominum.
and his appearance, among the sons of men.
super ipsum continebunt reges os suum:
kings will close their mouth because of him.
quia quibus non est narratum de eo viderunt,
And those to whom he was not described, have seen.
et qui non audierunt contemplati sunt.
And those who have not heard, have considered.
